description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs a series of tests involving Git's fast-import functionality, repository commits, notes, fanout schemes, and their interactions. It contains script logic to create commits, notes, perform updates and deletions, and verify their effects within a Git repository, primarily used for testing purposes.

methods.name: fast_import_commits
methods.description: Generates a specified number of commits with a given reference, appending commands to a file for batch importing.

methods.name: fast_import_notes
methods.description: Creates notes associated with specific commits across multiple references, appending commands to a file for batch import.
